fetch_pr.description: Fetch the pull request file diff from GitHub.

write_review.description: Review the pull request diff and produce a structured code review with risk assessment, key changes, a recommendation, and a review comment ready to post on the PR.

key_changes.description: Up to 5 key changes, as bullet-point strings

review_comment.description: Full review comment text to post on the PR

confirm_review.description: Present the AI-generated code review to the engineer and wait for them to confirm the outcome — approve or request changes — before any write reaches GitHub.

resolution_messages.approve: Approved — review comment posted to GitHub PR.
resolution_messages.request_changes: Changes requested — review comment posted to GitHub PR.

post_approval.description: Post the review comment on the GitHub PR (approve path).

post_changes_request.description: Post the review comment on the GitHub PR (request_changes path).
